### [llm-meta-ai 0.2](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/12/llm-meta-ai/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-12

Simon Willison updated the llm-meta-ai plugin to version 0.2 to support Meta's newly released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full models.

- Meta AI released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which Artificial Analysis scores as equivalent to GPT-6.1 Sol (Max variant).
- Muse Wonder supports six reasoning levels: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, and max.
- Meta AI has maintained a monthly release cadence, previously releasing Muse 1.2 on August 5th and Muse 1.3 on September 2nd.

**Why it matters:** The updated plugin enables developers to access Meta's latest Fable-class models directly through the LLM CLI ecosystem.

### [Singapore office and government MOU \| Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/singapore-office-opening)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-14

Anthropic opened its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signed an MOU with Singapore's Ministry of Digital Development and Information to collaborate on AI safety, evaluation, and adoption.

- The MOU targets joint work in AI safety, security, model evaluation, research on AI's societal impact, and responsible adoption in public and private sectors.
- Anthropic models power daily services for regional organizations including GovTech Singapore, Grab, and DBS.
- The agreement builds on earlier collaborations starting in 2023, including the IMDA and AI Verify Foundation's Generative AI Evaluation Sandbox and a multilingual red-teaming project covering English, Mandarin, Malay, and Tamil.

**Why it matters:** The partnership expands Anthropic's physical footprint in the APAC region while deepening state-level collaboration on multilingual AI safety testing and deployment benchmarks.

### [Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B](https://huggingface.co/blog/LiquidAI/lfm25-24b-a2b)

**Hugging Face** · 2026-10-13

Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, an open-weights mixture-of-experts model optimized for fast, private, on-device agentic workflows.

- Features a 24B total parameter architecture with an active-to-total ratio (A2B) of 2.1B parameters during inference.
- Uses Liquid Neural Network and MoE architecture design to achieve sub-millisecond per-token latency on local hardware.
- Optimized for local tool use, multi-turn task execution, and privacy-preserving autonomous agent deployment.

**Why it matters:** It enables developers to run low-latency, highly capable agentic AI pipelines locally without relying on cloud infrastructure or compromising user data privacy.

### [Redesigning source control at Anthropic](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/13/redesigning-source-control-at-anthropic/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-13

Anthropic replaced Git with a custom centralized source control system named Scion and a code review system named Antique to handle massive AI-driven code generation scaling.

- Daily merged code changes grew from approximately 2,500 in May 2026 to over 30,000 in September 2026.
- Main branch history reached nearly 100 GB with a compressed working copy over 25 GB, generating 25 million daily checkouts for CI, agents, and research.
- A team of seven engineers built Scion and completed the migration from Git in five months.
- Scion omits offline support because its primary user, Claude, operates entirely online.
- Engineers used adversarial review to build the system, requiring human oversight to prevent the model from over-engineering for hypothetical concerns.

**Why it matters:** Traditional distributed version control systems like Git fail at the scale required for high-velocity, automated LLM code generation, forcing AI labs to build custom centralized infrastructure.

`git` `version-control` `anthropic` `scion` `llms`
